_comment: The shared cue library. One catalogue that every protocol draws from, filtered by tag.
This replaces the fifteen StimulusList_*.js files the legacy tree carried, each a fork of
the last with the unwanted entries commented out -- StimulusList_mipuzzleA1.js ships 45
entries of which 26 are commented. A protocol here names the cues it uses; nothing is ever
commented out, and adding a paradigm adds pictures rather than forking a catalogue.
`root` is where image/video/audio paths resolve from, relative to this file.
`legacyCode` is the integer the cue had in the old catalogue, carried so an analysis script
written against the old marker numbers still finds what it expects.
Every cue below is text or blank on purpose: the shipped demonstration runs on a machine
that has never seen this lab, with no image assets at all.
